hints.title: Opposing Sort Heuristic
hints.text: To minimize the maximum total completion time, pair processors that start latest with tasks that finish quickest.

hints.title: Core Grouping
hints.text: Each processor executes 4 tasks concurrently. The completion time of that processor is processorTime[i] plus the largest of its 4 assigned tasks.

hints.title: Stride-4 Mapping
hints.text: Sort processorTime ascending and tasks descending. The maximum time is max(processorTime[i] + tasks[4 * i] for i in range(len(processorTime))).

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all permutations of task assignments is factorial.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Pair opposing sorted orders with stride 4.
